item.title: A record three Clubs strike gold in EFL's Equality Code of Practice
item.description: Middlesbrough, Plymouth Argyle and Salford City have all achieved Gold in the first wave of 2025/26 Equality Code of Practice (ECOP) results, the highest possible standard and a landmark moment for the programme. They’re the first of 13 Clubs to receive their results this season, each demonstrating exceptional commitment to putting equality, diversity and inclusion at the heart of how they operate.
